mapper.select: SELECT B.USER_ID, B.LEAVE_YEAR, B.TOTAL_DAYS, B.USED_DAYS, (B.TOTAL_DAYS - B.USED_DAYS - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(R.DAYS) FROM LEAVE_REQUEST R WHERE R.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND R.STATUS = 'REQUESTED' AND SUBSTRING(R.START_DE, 1, 4) = B.LEAVE_YEAR ), 0)) AS REMAIN_DAYS FROM LEAVE_BALANCE B WHERE B.USER_ID = #{userId} AND B.LEAVE_YEAR = #{leaveYear}

SELECT R.LEAVE_ID, R.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, R.LEAVE_TYPE, R.START_DE, R.END_DE, R.DAYS, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.APPROVER_ID, A.USER_NM AS APPROVER_NM, R.APPROVED_DT, R.REJECT_REASON, R.REGIST_DT, R.UPDT_DT FROM LEAVE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN APP_USER A ON A.USER_ID = R.APPROVER_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.START_DE LIKE #{leaveYear} || '%' ORDER BY R.START_DE DESC, R.REGIST_DT DESC, R.LEAVE_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LEAVE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID
AND R.START_DE LIKE #{leaveYear} || '%'
AND R.STATUS = #{status}
AND (R.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR U.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR R.REASON LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LEAVE_BALANCE B JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE B.LEAVE_YEAR = #{leaveYear}
AND (B.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR U.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM FROM APP_USER WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY USER_NM, USER_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT R.LEAVE_ID, R.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, R.LEAVE_TYPE, R.START_DE, R.END_DE, R.DAYS, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.APPROVER_ID, A.USER_NM AS APPROVER_NM, R.APPROVED_DT, R.REJECT_REASON, R.REGIST_DT, R.UPDT_DT FROM LEAVE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID LEFT JOIN APP_USER A ON A.USER_ID = R.APPROVER_ID WHERE R.LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId}
SELECT HOLIDAY_DE FROM HOLIDAY WHERE HOLIDAY_DE BETWEEN #{fromDe} AND #{toDe} ORDER BY HOLIDAY_DE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(DAYS), 0) FROM LEAVE_REQUEST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'REQUESTED' AND START_DE LIKE #{leaveYear} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LEAVE_REQUEST ( LEAVE_ID, USER_ID, LEAVE_TYPE, START_DE, END_DE, DAYS, REASON, STATUS, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{leaveId}, #{userId}, #{leaveType}, #{startDe}, #{endDe}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE LEAVE_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', APPROVER_ID = #{approverId}, APPROVED_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId} AND STATUS = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE LEAVE_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', APPROVER_ID = #{approverId}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId} AND STATUS = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE LEAVE_BALANCE SET USED_DAYS = USED_DAYS + #{days}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND LEAVE_YEAR = #{leaveYear} AND USED_DAYS + #{days} <= TOTAL_DAYS
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LEAVE_BALANCE ( USER_ID, LEAVE_YEAR, TOTAL_DAYS, USED_DAYS, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{leaveYear}, #{totalDays}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
